title: RETRACTION: Optimizing Two‐Stage Anaerobic Digestion for Circular Economy: Bioenergy Production and Waste Valorization
content:
RETRACTION: S. Sharma, P.K. Meena, C. Nayak, L. Singh, S. Shelare, and C.S. Wagle, “ Optimizing Two-Stage Anaerobic Digestion for Circular Economy: Bioenergy Production and Waste Valorization,” Environmental Progress & Sustainable Energy 44, no. 6 (2025): e70082, https://doi.org/10.1002/ep.70082.

The above article, published online on 8 August 2025 in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, Martin Abraham; the American Institute of Chemical Engineers; and John Wiley & Sons, Inc. Following publication, a third party alerted the journal that the article contains significant overlap with an earlier article by different authors (Mazzanti et al. 2024: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rser.2024.114938). Upon investigation, it was discovered that in addition to a high similarity in the content of the two articles, Figures 1 and 2 in the present article appear to have been copied from the earlier publication (Mazzanti et al. 2024) without permission. The data provided in the tables of the present article are also nearly identical with those of the earlier publication. Because of strong evidence that the contents of the present article include significant unattributed overlap with the previous article, the present article must be retracted. The authors state that there was no deliberate intention to misappropriate or misrepresent the work of others, but recognize that the overlap of figures and data is a violation of the journal's guidelines. The authors sincerely apologize for this oversight.
